entry.title: New: Resolution 485 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A ONE-YEAR INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAIʻI AND THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI FOR A RADIO REPEATER SITE

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into an agreement to install an amateur radio repeater on the summit of Mauna Kea for the purpose of an island-wide community emergency radio communications network to facilitate the Hawai‘i County Auxiliary Communications Service.
